Name: Get App Builder Updates
Description: System Workflow to Check for PAA Updates

Actions.Description: Check if app is marked as Development
Clear tables before getting new entries

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
-- Clear Updates table before getting new entries
DELETE FROM dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates

-- Clear Hotfixes table before getting new entries
DELETE FROM dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_Hotfixes

-- Clear Specific Updates table before getting new entries
DELETE FROM dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_SpecificUpdates

-- Clear Add-ons table before getting new entries
DELETE FROM dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_Addons

-- Clear Cumulative Hotfixes Package table before getting new entries
DELETE FROM paa.Updates_CumulativeHotfixes

-- Clear Cumulative Hotfixes table before getting new entries
DELETE FROM paa.Updates_Cumulative

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
SELECT Title, DnnFriendlyName, Version
INTO #TempUpdates
FROM OPENJSON(@json)
WITH (
    Title NVARCHAR(450),
    DnnFriendlyName NVARCHAR(450),
    Version NVARCHAR(450)
);

CREATE INDEX IX_TempUpdates_DnnFriendlyName ON #TempUpdates(DnnFriendlyName);

INSERT INTO dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates (Title, DnnFriendlyName, Version, CreatedDate)
SELECT 
    s.Title,
    s.DnnFriendlyName,
    s.Version,
    GETDATE()
FROM #TempUpdates AS s
LEFT JOIN dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates AS t WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
    ON t.DnnFriendlyName = s.DnnFriendlyName
WHERE t.DnnFriendlyName IS NULL;

DROP TABLE #TempUpdates;

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
SELECT
    FeatureType,
    ChangeType,
    [Date],
    Version,
    DnnFriendlyName,
    Details,
    Product AS ProductId,
    Link,
    State,
    Priority,
    [Order]
INTO #TempHotfixes
FROM OPENJSON(@json)
WITH (
    FeatureType NVARCHAR(450),
    ChangeType NVARCHAR(450),
    [Date] DATE,
    Version NVARCHAR(450),
    DnnFriendlyName NVARCHAR(450),
    Details NVARCHAR(MAX),
    Product NVARCHAR(450),
    Link NVARCHAR(2000),
    State NVARCHAR(450),
    Priority INT,
    [Order] INT
);

CREATE INDEX IX_TempHotfixes_DnnFriendlyName ON #TempHotfixes(DnnFriendlyName);

INSERT INTO dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_Hotfixes (
    FeatureType, ChangeType, [Date], Version, DnnFriendlyName, Details,
    InstalledVersion, ProductId, Link, State, CreatedDate, Priority, [Order]
)
SELECT
    h.FeatureType,
    h.ChangeType,
    h.[Date],
    h.Version,
    h.DnnFriendlyName,
    h.Details,
    p.Version AS InstalledVersion,
    h.ProductId,
    h.Link,
    h.State,
    GETDATE(),
    h.Priority,
    h.[Order]
FROM #TempHotfixes AS h
LEFT JOIN dbo.{objectQualifier}Packages AS p
    ON p.FriendlyName = h.DnnFriendlyName
LEFT JOIN dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_Hotfixes AS t WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
    ON t.ProductId = h.ProductId
WHERE t.ProductId IS NULL
  AND ISNULL(p.Version,'00.00.00') <> '00.00.00'
  AND (
        CAST(PARSENAME(h.Version,3) AS INT) > CAST(PARSENAME(ISNULL(p.Version,'0.0.0'),3) AS INT)
     OR (CAST(PARSENAME(h.Version,3) AS INT) = CAST(PARSENAME(ISNULL(p.Version,'0.0.0'),3) AS INT)
         AND CAST(PARSENAME(h.Version,2) AS INT) > CAST(PARSENAME(ISNULL(p.Version,'0.0.0'),2) AS INT))
     OR (CAST(PARSENAME(h.Version,3) AS INT) = CAST(PARSENAME(ISNULL(p.Version,'0.0.0'),3) AS INT)
         AND CAST(PARSENAME(h.Version,2) AS INT) = CAST(PARSENAME(ISNULL(p.Version,'0.0.0'),2) AS INT)
         AND CAST(PARSENAME(h.Version,1) AS INT) > CAST(PARSENAME(ISNULL(p.Version,'0.0.0'),1) AS INT))
  );

DROP TABLE #TempHotfixes;

SELECT 
    Product, 
    Version, 
    Info, 
    Link, 
    State, 
    Priority
INTO #TempSpecificUpdates
FROM OPENJSON(@json)
WITH (
    Product NVARCHAR(450),
    Version NVARCHAR(450),
    Info NVARCHAR(MAX),
    Link NVARCHAR(2000),
    State NVARCHAR(450),
    Priority INT
);

CREATE INDEX IX_TempSpecificUpdates_Product_Version ON #TempSpecificUpdates(Product, Version);

INSERT INTO dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_SpecificUpdates (
    Product, Version, Info, Link, State, CreatedDate, Priority
)
SELECT 
    s.Product,
    s.Version,
    s.Info,
    s.Link,
    s.State,
    GETDATE(),
    s.Priority
FROM #TempSpecificUpdates AS s
LEFT JOIN dbo.{objectQualifier}PlantAnApp_Updates_SpecificUpdates AS t WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
    ON t.Product = s.Product AND t.Version = s.Version
WHERE t.Product IS NULL;

DROP TABLE #TempSpecificUpdates;

ActionParameters.Name: SqlQuery
ActionParameters.Value:
SELECT
    Id,
    Title,
    Description,
    [Date],
    Severity,
    Priority,
    Packages AS PackagesJSON
INTO #TempCumulative
FROM OPENJSON(@json)
WITH (
    Id INT,
    Title NVARCHAR(450),
    Description NVARCHAR(MAX),
    [Date] DATE,
    Severity NVARCHAR(450),
    Priority INT,
    Packages NVARCHAR(MAX)
);

CREATE INDEX IX_TempCumulative_Id ON #TempCumulative(Id);

INSERT INTO paa.Updates_Cumulative (
    Id, Title, Description, [Date], Severity, Priority
)
SELECT 
    s.Id,
    s.Title,
    s.Description,
    s.[Date],
    s.Severity,
    s.Priority
FROM #TempCumulative AS s
LEFT JOIN paa.Updates_Cumulative AS t WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
    ON t.Id = s.Id
WHERE t.Id IS NULL;

INSERT INTO paa.Updates_CumulativeHotfixes (
    Id, CumulativeId, FeatureType, ChangeType, [Date], Version, DnnFriendlyName, Title,
    Details, InstalledVersion, ProductID, Link, Severity, Priority, [Order]
)
SELECT
    p.ProductChangeId,
    c.Id AS CumulativeId,
    p.FeatureType,
    p.ChangeType,
    p.[Date],
    p.Version,
    p.DnnFriendlyName,
    p.Title AS PackageTitle,
    p.Details,
    i.Version AS InstalledVersion,
    p.ProductId,
    p.Link,
    p.Severity AS PackageSeverity,
    p.Priority AS PackagePriority,
    p.[Order]
FROM #TempCumulative AS c
CROSS APPLY OPENJSON(c.PackagesJSON)
WITH (
    ProductChangeId INT,
    ProductId INT,
    DnnFriendlyName NVARCHAR(450),
    FeatureType NVARCHAR(450),
    Title NVARCHAR(MAX),
    Details NVARCHAR(MAX),
    ChangeType NVARCHAR(450),
    Severity NVARCHAR(450),
    Priority INT,
    Version NVARCHAR(450),
    [Date] DATE,
    Link NVARCHAR(2000),
    [Order] INT
) AS p
LEFT JOIN dbo.{objectQualifier}Packages AS i ON i.FriendlyName = p.DnnFriendlyName
LEFT JOIN paa.Updates_CumulativeHotfixes AS t WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK)
    ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID AND t.CumulativeId = c.Id
WHERE 
    t.ProductID IS NULL
    AND ISNULL(i.Version,'00.00.00') <> '00.00.00'
    AND (
        CAST(PARSENAME(p.Version,3) AS INT) > CAST(PARSENAME(ISNULL(i.Version,'0.0.0'),3) AS INT)
        OR (
            CAST(PARSENAME(p.Version,3) AS INT) = CAST(PARSENAME(ISNULL(i.Version,'0.0.0'),3) AS INT)
            AND CAST(PARSENAME(p.Version,2) AS INT) > CAST(PARSENAME(ISNULL(i.Version,'0.0.0'),2) AS INT)
        )
        OR (
            CAST(PARSENAME(p.Version,3) AS INT) = CAST(PARSENAME(ISNULL(i.Version,'0.0.0'),3) AS INT)
            AND CAST(PARSENAME(p.Version,2) AS INT) = CAST(PARSENAME(ISNULL(i.Version,'0.0.0'),2) AS INT)
            AND CAST(PARSENAME(p.Version,1) AS INT) > CAST(PARSENAME(ISNULL(i.Version,'0.0.0'),1) AS INT)
        )
    );

DELETE c
FROM paa.Updates_Cumulative AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM paa.Updates_CumulativeHotfixes AS h
    WHERE h.CumulativeId = c.Id
);

DROP TABLE #TempCumulative;
